review.feedback: English draft resting on a snapshot of the history and of the 255 files of state/streeling/courses at Demerzel commit 4b03838800dcd4894f1e026461979bff1d985ca8, on four hand-written forecast records checked by 22 field rules, and on a deterministic analysis whose 22 self-checks pass. The base rate (2 of 36 department-windows) rests on two windows and moves with their alignment, below 10% at only 10 of 23 alignments, so the research cycle's conclusion is insufficient; the worked forecasts about the Music department are exercises, not commitments of the department, and every scored outcome is invented. No record has resolved or been timestamped by a third party. Human subject review, learner trial and publication remain pending; the French and Spanish translations have had no native-speaker review.
